title: Corso: government panic over UFOs at New Mexico V-2 and nuclear sites

tellings.quote: And if you read Philip Corso's The Day After Roswell, the US government went into panic mode because they started seeing a lot of them down in New Mexico where they were testing the V-2 rockets,

plain: Around 1947 the US government went into panic because many UFOs were being seen in New Mexico, where it was testing V-2 rockets, the German-designed rockets of that era, and working on nuclear weapons. The physicist John Brandenburg says so, citing the book The Day After Roswell by Philip J. Corso, and tells it to suggest the craft were drawn to America's rocket and nuclear sites.
